text: This state's city of Gary was founded by US Steel. (*) Its capital is home to a famous 500-mile auto race. For 10 points, name this Midwestern state that borders Illinois and Ohio, with capital Indianapolis.
This author wrote about a giant dog on the Baskerville moors. (*) He also created the character Dr. John Watson. For 10 points, name this British author who created the detective Sherlock Holmes.
This musical instrument contains a bell, a spit valve, and a long outer slide (*) rather than valves. For 10 points, name this brass instrument whose name translates from Italian as 'large trumpet'.
This country's city of Istanbul borders the Bosporus strait. (*) For 10 points, name this transcontinental nation whose capital is Ankara.
This planet is home to the massive storm known as the Great Red Spot (*) and has the most moons in the solar system. For 10 points, name this largest planet in our solar system.
This element has the atomic number 1 and is the most abundant (*) chemical substance in the universe. For 10 points, name this lightest element on the periodic table, represented by the letter H.
This author wrote about the magical wardrobe that leads to the land of Narnia. (*) For 10 points, name this British author of The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe.
This mathematical operation represents repeated addition. (*) Its result is called a product. For 10 points, name this operation often represented by an 'X' or a dot.
